nodes.label: Asynchronous Judging
nodes.rationale: Council run exceeds request time, so POST judge returns 202 and runs via waitUntil (maxDuration 300s); results page polls.

nodes.label: Pitch Upload and Parsing
nodes.rationale: Uploads capped at 4MB due to Vercel request body limit.

nodes.label: Supabase (Postgres, RLS, magic-link auth)
nodes.rationale: RLS depends on requests carrying the user's token, so only the anon/public key is used, never the service-role key.

nodes.label: 2-Stage Council
nodes.rationale: No pairwise peer-review round, to stay within OpenRouter free-tier rate limits: 7 calls per judged idea instead of 40+.

nodes.label: Vercel Services Deployment
nodes.rationale: One project and one deployment serving frontend at / and backend at /api, same origin so CORS_ORIGIN and VITE_API_BASE_URL are unneeded.
